facts.summary: Positive Phase 2 PK data announced, no explanation for drop · Phase 2 · NS002 intranasal epinephrine in anaphylaxis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Nasus Pharma Announces Positive Top Line Data from Phase 2 Clinical Study of NS002: Achieves Significantly Superior and Faster Epinephrine Delivery Compared to EpiPen®
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: NS002 demonstrated significantly faster time to the critical 100 pg/mL epinephrine threshold compared to EpiPen®, with a median T100 of 1.69 minutes versus 3.42 minutes (p=0.033).
evidence.safety: NS002 demonstrated a favorable safety and tolerability profile consistent with previous studies, with no serious adverse events reported.
evidence.program_discontinued: Pivotal study initiation planned for fourth quarter of 2026
